definitions: To be in a difficult situation where one must choose between two equally undesirable options.
To be in a dilemma with no easy solution.
examples: She was between a rock and a hard place, needing to either quit her job or move.
He felt between a rock and a hard place, unable to please both his boss and his team.
lemma: to be between a rock and a hard place
synonyms: on the horns of a dilemma
between the devil and the deep blue sea
source: to be between a rock and a hard place
